name: Table 2-32: Xenos Construction
_doc: Roll for an Alien Technology artefact to determine the xenos design style. Ramshackle weapons additionally roll a second Quirk.

rows.name: Ramshackle
rows.description: Brutal, crude, slap-dash construction. Often Ork or feral xenos work. Weapons additionally roll a second Quirk.

rows.name: Peerless Elegance
rows.description: Eldar-style construction: flowing, deceptively delicate, devastating.

rows.name: Innovative Design
rows.description: A bizarre engineering approach humans cannot fully understand, but which works.

rows.name: Remnant of the Endless
rows.description: Construction reminiscent of the metallic creations of long-vanished species (e.g. Necrontyr) -- alarmingly self-repairing.

rows.name: Death-Dream's Fragment
rows.description: Construction that seems to draw on the Warp -- subtly cursed, often Yu'Vath or otherwise abhorrent.
